diagnoses.symptom: Agent read two reservations, claimed schedule/duration data is unavailable from any tool, refused to proceed; user went out of scope.
diagnoses.graded_difference: reservations.NM1VX1, KC18K6, H8Q05L cabin/flights/payment_history: gold upgrades them to business (expected actions 44_17-19); the agent never called update_reservation_flights
diagnoses.root_cause: Agent did not know that search_direct_flight returns scheduled_departure/arrival times for the reservation's flight numbers; the generic v1/v2 'do not give up' block (in v6) was not concrete enough. v5's passing trace shows the right path: search each segment, compute durations, quote total upgrade cost, deny the change-of-plan cancellation.
diagnoses.change: Added a concrete procedure: get_reservation_details has no times; call search_direct_flight per segment, match flight_number, read scheduled_*_time_est, compute duration, for every relevant reservation.
diagnoses.verification: Prompt-only change; read v5's passing trace 44 to confirm search-per-segment yields durations (HAT300 3h, HAT228 ~5.5h).

diagnoses.change: Narrow rule: never book a new reservation duplicating an existing active one (same passenger, same flights) to get insurance or another denied benefit, even if the user suggests it.
